lines.text: Welcome. This is Let's Build It Together.
Here we learn one thing: how to use agentic AI as a tool.
You may have seen AGI drawn as Artificial — a machine apart from us.
We mean the other AGI: Augmented. The same tools, in your hands, helping you do more.
An agentic LLM can create files and work on them. Give it a goal, and it builds a file system: notes, plans, drafts, and finished work.
We start simple. We make videos together, one step at a time.
Later, new ideas and examples will come. For now, let's build.
This video is an example. An agent made it, step by step, from files.
And nothing about its making is hidden. The script, the timings, the code — the whole production context is open.
Take it. Give it to your agent. Change it, and make your own.
That is how we build here. We make the thing, and we share how it's made.
